decision: Retain KSM-66 root extract as a human training-associated functional reserve. Preserve the 2015 direct strength positives and later estimated-endurance/public-data sensitivity positives; later strength confirmation remains unresolved rather than a definitive primary failure. No demonstrated BUBR1 restoration, MVA efficacy or comparative clinical superiority.
preparation_boundary: A branded multicomponent root preparation. The studies report 5% and >5% withanolides respectively, with 2015 lot identity unavailable and 2024 batch KSM/VG/18/1020. Same brand does not prove batch equivalence or transfer to isolated constituents, leaf preparations or arbitrary retail products.

citation.title: Examining the effect of Withania somnifera supplementation on muscle strength and recovery: a randomized controlled trial
citation.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

studies.decision: Retain a preparation-specific, controlled human strength-training compensation signal for independent appraisal. It supplies a more controlled functional design than niacin’s open-label strength evidence, without establishing superior clinical benefit, BUBR1 restoration, MVA transfer or an alternative to pediatric apitegromab evidence.

preparation.name: KSM-66 high-concentration Withania somnifera root extract
preparation.manufacturer: Ixoreal BioMed, Los Angeles, California, USA
preparation.extraction: Reported water-based process without alcohol/other extraction solvents
preparation.standardization: 5% withanolides measured by HPLC, as reported; no independent lot certificate or compositional reanalysis supplied
preparation.capsule: Local laboratory filled cellulose-based vegetarian capsules with 300 mg extract or 300 mg starch; identical appearance, weight and texture reported
preparation.source_exposure: One capsule twice daily for eight weeks; total extract 600 mg/day, a description of the trial rather than advice
preparation.comparator: 300 mg starch capsule twice daily, with the same prescribed resistance-training program
preparation.availability_context: NCCIH describes marketed ashwagandha supplements as root, leaf or root/leaf extracts; no current retailer/SKU or chemical-equivalence verification performed.

design.reported_design: Prospective randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group study
design.population: Healthy men aged 18–50 with little resistance-training experience; completer mean ages 28±8 and 29±9 years
design.setting: Recruited near a gymnasium in India; participants compensated with gym membership and professional trainer support
design.randomization_limits: Sequence generation and allocation concealment not described; native flow diagram identifies randomization
design.blinding_limits: Identical capsules reported, but assessor-specific masking and blinding-success assessment not reported
design.cointervention: Eight weeks of prescribed resistance training for both groups, with initial two-week acclimatization and subsequent progressive periodization
design.isolated_extract_effect: No extract-only arm; observed comparison is extract plus training versus placebo plus training
design.adherence: Pill-count check at four weeks described; no quantitative adherence results or detailed diet/workload accounting reported
design.hierarchy: Publication labels muscle strength primary, measured with two exercise outcomes; muscle size, body composition, testosterone and CK-defined recovery secondary

registry.main_report: No registry identifier, recruitment dates or public protocol/SAP reported in the inspected scientific main. Strength is an author-stated primary endpoint, not independently verified prospective registration.
registry.clinicaltrials_gov: Exact-title API query returned zero studies; response retained. This does not prove absence of registration under another title or registry.
indexed_search_queries: "Examining the effect of Withania somnifera supplementation" registration CTRI
registry.indexed_search_result: No matching study record identified. A returned 2015 female sexual-function trial and later unrelated studies were not imported. No claim of exhaustive registry coverage.
registry.registration_timing: UNKNOWN; no matched registration or enrollment chronology to compare.
registry.prospective_hierarchy: UNKNOWN beyond the publication calling strength primary and size/body composition/testosterone/CK recovery secondary.

design.sample_size: No formal power/sample-size calculation located in the main report
design.statistics: ANOVA with group as factor; Mann–Whitney for nonnormal data; chi-square for tolerability; alpha .05. Multiplicity adjustment not described.

flow.analysis: Completer/available-case analysis. No reported intention-to-treat contrast or missing-data sensitivity analysis; losses after randomization total seven.

strength_measurement.timepoints: First day of training and two days after the eight-week program ended
strength_measurement.instrument: Precor DPL0802 bench-press and DSL0605 leg-extension machines
strength_measurement.method: Reported 1RM using a variant of Baechle–Earle–Wathen multiple-RM protocol. Training loads estimated using prediction equations. Do not relabel this as a direct dynamometer force measurement.
strength_measurement.functional_scope: Task-specific load strength in novice trainees; not walking, daily function, diseased-muscle rescue or absolute tissue force.

primary_outcomes.derived_difference_provenance: 46.05 minus 26.42; arithmetic from source means, not a separate reported effect estimate
primary_outcomes.ci_warning: Published CIs describe each arm’s change, not the between-arm difference.
primary_outcomes.source: Native Table 2 and Results; Figure 2a shows pre/post bars

primary_outcomes.ci_warning: Within-arm change CIs cannot be presented as treatment-difference CIs. Nominal P=.04 without a reported multiplicity procedure.

secondary_outcomes.arm_size: Estimated arm CSA change 8.89 versus 5.30 cm², P=.01; calculated from girth/skinfolds, not imaging. Abstract reports 8.6 rather than native Table 3’s 8.89.
secondary_outcomes.chest: Girth change 3.37 versus 1.43 cm, P=.0002 in native Table 3; not muscle-volume imaging.
secondary_outcomes.thigh_null: Estimated CSA change 8.71 versus 6.22 cm², P=.36; final between-group P=.9.
secondary_outcomes.testosterone: Change +96.19 versus +18.00 ng/dL, P=.004; final levels 726.64 versus 693.12 ng/dL, P=.42. No mediation test.

ck_recovery.definition: Increase in serum CK from 24 to 48 hours after the first/last exercise session; training-related change in that increment
ck_recovery.interpretation: Biomarker metric, not raw CK at one timepoint or directly measured strength recovery. Narrative/abstract sign formatting differs; native Table 6 retains negative changes and negative CIs.

harms.trial: Results state no serious side effects; all subjects rated PGATT tolerability good/excellent and groups did not differ. Detailed adverse-event counts and separate safety-analysis denominator not given. Discussion says no side effects, a broader formulation than Results.
harms.limits: Eight weeks with 50 efficacy completers cannot establish rare-event, long-term, pediatric, cancer-context or interaction safety. Withdrawals are reported as stopping training, not assigned an adverse-event cause.

external_context.scope: Availability/safety guidance only, not efficacy evidence
external_context.findings: Notes preparation variation, possible drowsiness/GI effects, rare liver-injury reports, thyroid/autoimmune and medication-interaction concerns; no inference that every product shares the trial’s composition or safety.

funding_notices.product_supply: Acknowledgments thank Shri Kartikeya Pharma and Ixoreal BioMed for KSM-66 extract
funding_notices.sponsor_role: Influence on design/analysis/publication not separately described; authors report their own design/data/analysis roles
funding_notices.conflicts: Authors declare no conflict of interests regarding publication
funding_notices.notices: No linked correction/retraction in fresh PubMed CommentsCorrections or Crossref update/relation fields; bounded check only
funding_notices.data_access: No raw participant data or prospective protocol obtained; no author contact

studies.reading_depth: Complete scientific main including Methods/Results/Discussion; native Figures 1–3; original PDF pages 6–8 with Tables 2–6. All other main tables read as official XML/HTML, not claimed visually inspected. No supplement linked in retrieved main.

identity.title: Effects of Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) standardized root extract on physical endurance and VO2max in healthy adults performing resistance training: An eight-week, prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study

studies.decision: Retain as mixed human training evidence with a positive published secondary endurance estimate and positive exploratory public-data contrasts, but unresolved strength claim/table/protocol/data discordance prevents treating this as clean confirmation of the 2015 strength result. It neither establishes a failed planned primary endpoint nor displaces disease-relevant nominees.

preparation.extraction: Proprietary extraction reported free of alcohol or similar solvents; full composition independently unverified.
preparation.control: 300 mg starch from Shri Kartikeya Pharma; matched cellulose hard capsules, appearance, weight, texture and color.
preparation.vehicle: Water or milk; milk reported for 3 active and 4 placebo participants, not analyzed separately.
preparation.transfer_limit: Same KSM-66 brand as 2015 does not verify lot equivalence or equivalence to generic powders, other extracts, or current retail products.

design.population: Healthy physically active men and women aged 18–45 years, with at least 3 months of gym or strength training before screening.
design.sites: King George Medical University and M. V. Hospital and Research Centre, Lucknow, India
design.allocation: Parallel, 1:1, computer-generated sex-stratified permuted blocks of 20; registry specifies sequentially numbered sealed opaque envelopes.
design.masking: Paper double blind; registry participant, investigator and outcome assessor blinded. Main says envelopes contained no allocation information while protocol p42 says they contained allocation; reporting inconsistency, not proof masking failed.
design.cointervention: Same prescribed 8-week resistance-training program, stated 3 sessions per week, with initial exercise progression. Instructions to preserve diet, without quantitative calorie/protein measurement.

excluded_after_randomization.reason: Poor supplementation compliance, not loss to follow-up. Three men in each arm plus one placebo woman. All received allocation and completed follow-up per Figure 2.
excluded_after_randomization.terminology: Article calls the adherence-selected 73 analysis modified ITT; it is not the all-exposed ITT specified in the protocol.

design.safety_endpoint_specific_n: Not supplied in the two-page safety appendix.

registration_and_protocol.timing_interpretation: Registration precedes both registry and manuscript enrollment dates; these dates differ. Current record verified, original time-stamped entry history not retrieved.
registration_and_protocol.registry_primary: Improvement in muscle strength from baseline to EOS, at 8 weeks.
registration_and_protocol.protocol_primary_p44: Percentage change in muscle strength from baseline to EOS.
registration_and_protocol.protocol_primary_other_pages: General improvement in muscle strength on pp13 and 20.
registration_and_protocol.protocol_publication: First present in Figshare v2 on 14 February 2023, identical MD5 in v3/v4. Internal 2018 date alone is not proof every current byte was prospectively public.
registration_and_protocol.protocol_analysis: ITT all participants receiving at least one dose and PP analysis; pragmatic 80-person exploratory/postmarketing justification; independent t tests; PP preferred if ITT/PP discordant; LOCF mentioned. p43 mixes noninferiority language and p45 states a 20% superiority margin; no directly reported margin-based analysis in paper.
registration_and_protocol.manuscript_analysis: Absolute change comparisons, t tests and ANCOVA. ANCOVA footnote names sex, baseline BMI and baseline chest circumference, not baseline strength outcome.
registration_and_protocol.omitted_or_changed_plan: CK recovery, testosterone and SF-36 assessments were planned but not reported in this article. Author response states no recovery measures were assessed. No retrieved SAP/amendment resolves these changes; companion publication pointer remains unqualified.
registration_and_protocol.wrong_registry_response: sources/ctri-old.html/.txt is unrelated CTRI/2018/09/015859 and is excluded from evidence.

narrative_claims.author_response_to_reviewer: Authors say narrative P values concern effect size, while table P values concern comparison of means (t test). The exact alternative inferential computation is not supplied; this does not reconcile the different treatment claims.
narrative_claims.within_arm: Paper also reports significant active-arm strength gains. These are not placebo-adjusted effects.
narrative_claims.version_continuity: v1 already contains the Table 3/4 strength results, with more decimals. v2 rounds tables, changes chest to bench terminology, adds safety data and removes Figures 3/4; the narrative/table mismatch remains.

interpretation_limits: No documented multiplicity adjustment across two strength outcomes, sex subgroup comparisons, anthropometry and endurance. No formal sex-by-treatment interaction identified.
Seven randomized, followed participants excluded for adherence. The public data do not identify which seven records were omitted.
Baseline BMI, mid-arm and chest differ at nominal P=.049, .029 and .002. Covariate adjustment is described, but not for the corresponding baseline strength outcome.
Lower-body task is called leg press in tables but leg extension in abstract/equipment description; do not silently equate tests.
Anthropometric tables report circumference in cm, not muscle mass or directly measured muscle volume/CSA despite methods wording.
VO2max is estimated from Bruce treadmill duration, not directly measured gas exchange.
No BUB1B/BUBR1 intervention assay, MVA cohort, long-term follow-up or pediatric/cancer safety evidence in this source.

public_data_check.method: Two-sided independent pooled-variance Student t test and Welch sensitivity test, 95% nominal CIs; no multiplicity correction.
public_data_check.analysis_set: All 80 publicly deposited complete records; no exclusions or imputation. The seven compliance exclusions are not identified by the public columns.
public_data_check.percentage_definition: 100*(Day56-Day0)/Day0, recomputed from unrounded deposited measurement values; percentage-point contrast.

critical_mismatch.interpretation: These within-subgroup mismatches cannot be resolved by the stated exclusions, since all 20 active women are retained. This is an unresolved provenance/consistency problem, not a finding of misconduct. Do not invent a 73-person subset or label all-80 calculations a reproduction.

workbook_inspection.summary: Independent reviewer found one 80-record sheet; no exclusion/compliance identifiers, hidden rows or comments; source measurements match CSV except BMI rounding; cached strength/VO2 percentage formulas match recomputation.
workbook_inspection.reanalysis_boundary: Reviewer ANCOVA uses the rounded CSV BMI and is exploratory. Copies are retained reviewer analysis, not a new execution by this source author.

safety.paper_claim: No adverse events reported in the 80-person safety set and no significant laboratory change from baseline to week 8.
safety.appendix_actual: Two native pages dated 28 March 2024. Many paired baseline-to-end tests are significant in both arms, including WBC, RBC and TSH (each P<.001). All shared comparison P values shown alongside baseline/end means exceed .05; the end comparison column is ambiguously headed Within group. No endpoint n, units or reference ranges are supplied.
safety.interpretation: Retain reported absence of AEs, but do not repeat a blanket no-laboratory-change claim. These summaries alone establish neither clinically important treatment harm nor broad safety. Healthy-adult 8-week observations do not establish long-term, pediatric, cancer or MVA safety.

funding_and_roles.manuscript: No grants involved; no competing interests disclosed; Ixoreal BioMed thanked for supplying root extract.
funding_and_roles.protocol: Shri Kartikeya Pharma sponsor; Abiogenesis Clinpharm Private Limited CRO.
funding_and_roles.official_registry: Shri Kartikeya Pharma is primary sponsor and source of monetary or material support.
funding_and_roles.interpretation: No-grants wording is not absence of commercial involvement. Exact financial amounts and sponsor role in final analysis not resolved.

cohort_overlap.with_2015: Reported 2018–2019 recruitment, distinct investigators/sites and mixed-sex previously active population support a separate trial from the earlier novice-men report. No participant-level crosswalk was available; shared KSM-66 product is not independent replication by itself.
cohort_overlap.versions: F1000 v1 and v2, Figshare versions, protocol, safety appendix and raw files are one trial, not additional cohorts.

companion_pointer.status: Primary-publisher search result associates this pointer with the same CTRI identifier; direct current PDF returned 404. Not fully qualified, not independently counted, and not used to claim missing endpoints absent from all publications.

notices.checked: Retained current PMC version, PubMed XML, Crossref metadata and public peer-review/author response in main XML.
notices.result: v2 revision and open review documented. No linked retraction or correction notice identified in these records; no universal notice-absence claim.
notices.access: Full main available as official XML/HTML. Publisher PDF 403, PMC PDF returned access challenge; no bypass. Native article Figures 1/2 and prior v1 Figures 3/4 viewed. Tables read as native published HTML/XML, not visually inspected in an original main PDF.

root_and_independent_clarifications.training2015: Methods describe three sessions weekly but Table 1 lists four day labels. Retain the prescribed-program comparison without claiming verified achieved schedule or workload.
root_and_independent_clarifications.chest2015: Use girth in cm from methods/Table 3; Figure 2e cm² is a source-label mismatch.
root_and_independent_clarifications.strength2024: Absolute published contrasts do not settle the protocol percentage primary. Independent all 80 public-data sensitivities include positive absolute and adjusted bench-percentage contrasts, but cannot reproduce the unidentified 73-person analysis or reconcile the unchanged active-female subgroup.
root_and_independent_clarifications.no_safety_upgrade: Paired laboratory changes in both arms are not automatically treatment-specific clinical harm; absence of reported adverse events is not broad safety proof.

public_data_replay.report_role: Exploratory all 80 posted-data calculation, not a verified all-randomized trial analysis or reproduction of the published 73-person set.

analysis.tests: Two-sided independent pooled-variance Student t test and Welch sensitivity test, 95% nominal CIs; no multiplicity correction.
analysis.percentage_definition: 100*(Day56-Day0)/Day0, recomputed from unrounded deposited measurement values; percentage-point contrast.

validation.scope: Reproducibility of the independently specified all80 public-data computation; not validation of the published73 analysis or clinical efficacy.

public_data_replay.limits: No excluded-row identities were inferred. Tests and exploratory ANCOVA are nominal, uncorrected, and do not implement an independently verified prospective trial SAP or protocol margin test. Raw participant rows are not included.

competitiveness.credit: The 2015 placebo-controlled task-strength comparison is a substantive design advantage over an uncontrolled functional trajectory. Later published endurance estimates and exploratory all 80 positives are retained rather than erased by reporting problems.
competitiveness.limits: Training cointerventions, healthy adult populations, preparation identity, completer/exclusion analyses, nominal multiplicity and unresolved later reporting/data consistency prevent a cleanly replicated disease-weakness claim.
competitiveness.nominees: Niacin/restoration and apitegromab/compensation remain provisional. Their missing MVA evidence is not demanded uniquely of challengers; cross-population endpoints do not establish a clinical winner.
competitiveness.next: Reconcile the trial estimand, exclusion map and deposited data. Test exact identifiable preparation at justified exposure for useful absolute function, renewal and chromosome fidelity in appropriate affected/corrected models. Functional BUBR1 mediation is additionally required only for restoration claims.
competitiveness.eligibility: Approved-drug submission eligibility and current product/lot availability are not established by this appraisal.

root_reading.2015: Complete primary qualification and independent review; official publisher abstract and selected main Methods; native Figure 1 and PDF page 6 including Table 2. Not a second complete root scientific-main read.
root_reading.2024: Complete primary qualification and independent findings; original Methods/Results and all table text within those sections; selected protocol pages including the percentage-primary, ITT/PP and sponsorship statements; complete structured all 80 strength/ANCOVA results inspected. Root did not independently read all peer reviews, safety pages or full protocol.
root_reading.independent: Separate 2015 and 2024 complete-main/native-outcome reviews; 2024 reviewer additionally checked official protocol/registry/version history and calculated public-data sensitivities. Exact scopes remain in their frozen packets.
root_reading.replay: Root inspected the independent numerical code, preserved its analysis body in a portable CLI, ran it once successfully against the exact archived public CSV, compared every result field, and verified changed-input/existing-output rejection. No new trial data or published 73-person reproduction.
